input.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `float32`, `float64`. A float32 or float64 tensor.

fft_length.description: A `Tensor` of type `int32`. An int32 tensor. The FFT length for each dimension.

axes.description: A `Tensor` of type `int32`. An int32 tensor with a same shape as fft_length. Axes to perform the transform.
constraints: axes must have the same shape as fft_length

Tcomplex.description: An optional `tf.DType` from: `tf.complex64, tf.complex128`. Defaults to `tf.complex64`. Should be `tf.complex64` when the type of `input` is `float32`. Should be `tf.complex128` when the type of `input` is `float64`.
